statements.impact_statement: Narrowly scoped to sqlite-libs 3.34.1-11.el9_8 in quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.8.2. CVE-2026-119586 is in the SQLite command-line shell's .recover command; the affected shell implementation is not part of the sqlite-libs shared library. The image contains only /usr/lib64/libsqlite3.so.0 and /usr/lib64/libsqlite3.so.0.8.6 for SQLite, has no sqlite3 executable, has no SQLite-named Keycloak/JVM JAR, and the runtime executable-link inspection found no binary linked to libsqlite3. The statement does not apply to the sqlite CLI package, other packages/images, or the separate FTS5 library issue CVE-2026-119373. Evidence: CI run 42231828253 runtime inventory; https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2563931; https://explore.alas.aws.amazon.com/CVE-2026-119586.html
